definition: a place where people buy and sell food and goods
description: In an animated old-town street market, a young woman with a basket walks between stalls under striped awnings. She picks ripe tomatoes from a friendly farmer, smells a peach, tastes cheese a vendor cuts for her, and strolls on through the busy stalls.
transcript: Fresh today! Very fresh! Mmm, two, please. Thank you, my dear.

taps.target: the man in the straw hat
